description: This file defines the 'ReportWeeklyScreen' widget for a Flutter attendance tracking app. It displays a weekly attendance report by fetching data asynchronously on initialization and rendering it as a list.

classes.name: ReportWeeklyScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the weekly report screen in the attendance tracker application.

classes.name: _ReportWeeklyScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the data and UI logic for ReportWeeklyScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, loads weekly report data asynchronously after the first frame.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, showing either a loading indicator or a list of weekly records.
